rationale_blocks.title: Why he matters without an article
rationale_blocks.body: Tann is Nadeau's pre-Japan aikido teacher — the AJ Encyclopedia names Nadeau among his students, and the timeline is consistent (Nadeau began late 1950s, Hombu early 1960s; Tann's SSF window 1960–72). The proposed Nadeau-article sentence lives in robert-nadeau.json (upd:nadeau:tann-teacher). Graph hygiene done: person:bob-tann and the malformed person:aikikai-hombu-dojo-bob-tann (spaCy junction artifact) are ALIAS_OF person:robert-tann, nodes retained for provenance.
